description: Field contract for authored animation clips and avatar animation profiles. Clip files under config/animations/library contain the actual poses.

clip_fields.durationTicks: positive integer; one fixed game tick per authored 60 FPS frame
clip_fields.aimLayer: boolean; defaults to true; false keeps the authored pose exact
clip_fields.rootTranslationScale: finite multiplier on authored part translation
clip_fields.speedMultiplier: positive multiplier on clip playback speed
clip_fields.lockTicks: -1 uses durationTicks; positive values are minimum fixed-tick ownership
clip_fields.partMask: optional array of part names owned by this clip
clip_fields.markers: array of named integer tick and optional sourceTick boundaries
clip_fields.keyframes: array of keyed poses at integer ticks

keyframe_fields.interp: linear, smooth, easein, easeout, easeinout, or step
keyframe_fields.parts: object keyed by rig part name

part_fields.translation: three finite meter offsets in the normalized rest frame
part_fields.rotationEulerDegrees: three finite Euler XYZ degree offsets; exclusive with quaternion
part_fields.rotationQuaternionWxyz: four finite values in WXYZ order; exclusive with Euler

avatar_profile_fields.set: optional ordered set id from animation-sets.json
avatar_profile_fields.states: default, locomotion, run, jump, fall, land, dash, downDash, freeze, knockback, crouch, crouchWalk, crouchIn, crouchOut, respawn, attack, equip, hurt, hurtSmall, hurtNormal, hurtLarge, death, deathSmall

animation_set_fields.order: integer ordering hint for editors and diagnostics
animation_set_fields.include: repository-relative clips or directories merged before the avatar profile
animation_set_fields.states: state map supplied by the set; inline avatar states override it

runtime_settings_fields.rootTranslationMode: 1 keeps authored part translation, 2 zeroes it
runtime_settings_fields.hurtTierMode: 1 uses percent of max HP, 2 uses fixed damage
runtime_settings_fields.hurtPercent: smallMax and normalMax percentages for mode 1
runtime_settings_fields.hurtFixed: smallMax and normalMax damage values for mode 2
runtime_settings_fields.statePriorities: state name to integer priority; higher wins
